name: fabius
description: fabius — one super-skill that equips Claude end-to-end under a single Fabian stance: scout wide, strike narrow. Write lean code and lean prose, run a disciplined brainstorm→plan→TDD→verify→debug loop, design ship-grade UI, visualize data, build and orchestrate other agents, market the value, harden security (defensive), build games, develop on-chain and cryptographically seal artifacts, wire automations, research the sciences, and keep a persistent memory so it stops re-deriving. One install, twelve coordinated zero-overlap skills: an always-on lean core, a router that dispatches by layer + machinery + model-tier, and ten engineering specialists. Capabilities: terse output, a YAGNI code ladder, root-cause debugging, design tokens + one-accent laws, data-ink charts + generative imagery, least-privilege agent definitions, index+log knowledge base with auto-recall, positioning + converting copy, STRIDE/OWASP threat-modeling + AI diff review, game-loop + juice, on-chain account-validation + verifiable provenance sealing, automation build-and-verify, the scientific method with reproducible pipelines. Actions: write, build, fix, debug, refactor, review, design, chart, plan, verify, remember, market, harden, play, seal, automate, research. Lean by default, never flimsy.
